questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure compute services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure virtual desktop
questions.question: Which statement best describes Azure Virtual Desktop?

options.text: Running resources only as needed and charging primarily for the execution resources consumed
A managed Azure service that provides virtual Windows desktops and applications to remote users
An App Service feature for running background programs or scripts on a schedule or trigger
Hosting desktops and applications in Azure rather than storing all application state on local user devices

questions.explanation: Azure Virtual Desktop is a managed Azure service that provides virtual Windows desktops and applications to remote users.

questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure virtual desktop
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Azure Virtual Desktop: a managed Azure service that provides virtual Windows desktops and applications to remote users.
Microsoft Entra ID integration: a burstable, cost-efficient VM family suited to workloads with occasional CPU spikes.
Centralized desktop delivery: hosting desktops and applications in Azure rather than storing all application state on local user devices.
Centralized desktop delivery: keeping application data in Azure-hosted sessions instead of on endpoint devices.
Azure Virtual Desktop: allowing multiple users to share Windows session-host infrastructure when appropriate.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Azure Virtual Desktop — a managed Azure service that provides virtual Windows desktops and applications to remote users; and Centralized desktop delivery — hosting desktops and applications in Azure rather than storing all application state on local user devices.
